svg.title: Full Agentic AI Pipeline — 12 Layers
svg.desc: A top-to-bottom flowchart of the complete agentic AI pipeline from user prompt through gateway, intent extraction, knowledge graph, RAG, orchestration, agent execution, evaluator critics, HITL, output, observability, and self-learning.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Deep dive: Stage 1 — User prompt and input channels for agentic AI')
g.text: Chat, API, voice, form, event trigger

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Deep dive: Stage 2 — AI gateway, PII masking, prompt injection, rate limiting')
g.text: PII mask · injection detect · RBAC · rate limit · cost cap

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Deep dive: Stage 3 — Intent classification and entity extraction for agentic AI')
g.text: Route to agent · NER · slot filling · query decompose

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Deep dive: Stage 4 — Knowledge graph construction and entity linking for RAG')
g.text: Neo4j · Neptune · entity linking · graph traversal

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Deep dive: Stage 5 — Advanced RAG patterns: Self-RAG, C-RAG, GraphRAG, HyDE, Fusion RAG')
sendPrompt('Deep dive: Stage 6 — Orchestration layer: LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, A2A, MCP')
g.text: LangGraph · CrewAI · AutoGen · MCP tools · A2A protocol

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Deep dive: Stage 7 — Agent execution layer: tool use, ReAct loop, sub-agents, self-debugging')
g.text: ReAct loop · sub-agents · code exec · web · DB · APIs

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Deep dive: Stage 8 — Evaluator critic layer: groundedness, policy, bias, hallucination scoring')
sendPrompt('Deep dive: Stage 9 — Output formatting, streaming, citations and response delivery')
sendPrompt('Deep dive: Stage 10 — Observability, LangSmith tracing, MLflow, audit logs, dashboards')
g.text: LangSmith · MLflow · OpenTelemetry · audit log · dashboards

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Deep dive: Stage 11 — Self-learning, drift detection, retraining triggers, model versioning')
g.text: Stage 11 · Self-learning + retraining · drift detect · DVC · model registry

svg.text: Click any stage to go deep on tools, models, and architecture decisions
